'''Ellis Tarn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] who was one of the leaders of the [[White Maw]]. During the [[Galactic War]], he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] when the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire]] invaded [[Coldstone Canyon]] and killed every leader of the White Maw.<ref name="Breaking the Maw" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' he can be spared by offering the White Maw leaders the option to surrender.<ref name="Breaking the Maw" />
